<!-- assumption-1: body_md -->
\label{assump:baseline}
    Each FOWT uses a baseline controller to regulate its stability and power output performance~\cite{NREL5MW}.
<!-- end assumption-1 -->
<!-- assumption-2: body_md -->
\label{assump:freestream}
    The freestream turbine FOWT\(_1\) always operates in a greedy manner.
<!-- end assumption-2 -->
<!-- assumption-3: body_md -->
\label{assump:measurements}
    Sensors on each FOWT can measure its blade load \(M_{n,t}\) and yaw angle \(\gamma_{n,t}\) at every time step \(t\).
<!-- end assumption-3 -->
<!-- assumption-4: body_md -->
\label{assump:communication}
    FOWT\(_n\) can communicate with its neighboring turbine FOWT\(_{n-1}\) by exchanging \(M_{n,t}\) and \(\gamma_{n,t}\) at each time step \(t\). In addition, \(M_{1,t}\) from the freestream turbine FOWT\(_1\) is broadcast to all FOWTs.
<!-- end assumption-4 -->
